_readme: Homepage testimonials data: ONE source for every testimonials layout (assets/demo-testimonials.js reads it). REAL member reviews, Owner-confirmed 2026-10-07 ("Yes, use them real reviews"); text is word for word from the members, never rephrase. Fields: name, initials, avatar (optional: the member's own photo, assets/images/testimonials/<initials>.webp; initials circle when absent), role (optional), when (optional ISO date the review was given; shown as relative time ONLY when set; we have no real dates, so none are set), text, source (optional), featured (optional: the big quote in the bento layout), hidden (true = kept in the file but not shown; always give a reason). To switch a hidden review back on, delete its hidden and reason keys.

reviews.name: Marcus T.
reviews.text: Just got my first payout with Stryker. The models and risk management framework make everything so much easier to follow. Solid community as well. Highly recommend.

reviews.name: Chris L.
reviews.text: The indicators alone are worth it. Clean, accurate and save me so much time. The lessons actually explain the why, not just random setups. Best $9 I’ve spent so far.

reviews.name: Emily R.
reviews.text: Been trading for a while and this is the first place that actually teaches everything in a structured way. The journal and backtesting tool are game changers. Really happy I joined.

reviews.name: Daniel K.
reviews.text: Passed my first prop firm challenge today using the Stryker models. The live sessions help a lot, and the community is super supportive. Thanks for building this!

reviews.name: Maya S.
reviews.text: The NY live sessions are next level. So much value just watching and asking questions. Everything is explained clearly and in a simple way. Highly recommend Stryker!

reviews.name: Ethan W.
reviews.text: Finally got consistent after joining Stryker. The structure, models and backtests made a huge difference. Wish I had this earlier.

reviews.name: Sarah M.
reviews.text: Amazing community and support. The live trading sessions really help put everything together. The education, indicators and journal are top tier. Best $9 I’ve spent.

reviews.name: Liam C.
reviews.text: Took 2 trades today using the IFVG model from Stryker. Both hit 1:1 exactly like in the lessons. The backtesting tool also helped me stay disciplined.

reviews.name: Kevin T.
reviews.text: The content is super detailed but still easy to understand. The charts, examples and models make it simple to apply. Stryker is legit.

reviews.name: Isabella N.
reviews.text: I’ve tried a lot of trading education but this is different. Everything is well organized and actually useful. The backtesting app is a huge plus. Highly recommend!

reviews.name: Riley J.
reviews.text: Just finished Module 4 and it finally clicked. The way it’s explained is so much better than anything else I’ve tried. The community here is solid too.

reviews.name: Jordan P.
reviews.text: Great models, clean indicators and real examples. The live sessions and community keep me accountable. Easily the best $9 I’ve spent on trading education.
